items.title: Jackie Williams interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: So, and I asked Tiny Bradshaw, who was a stomping band, you know, he wanted to hear it you know?

ctx.x: Fifties. Late fifties. Medium fifties, you know. Yeah, medium fifties, late fifties around that time, going into the sixties. Well they were doing the Lindy, formal, like ballroom, they were doing mambos. The mambo was coming out. Then a lot of Latin and mambo and stuff like that. And calypso, they did calypso, jitterbug, swing-type dancing, ballroom dancing, and they always did some kind of creative things, you know. So I used to get a lot of gigs playing with some groups, local groups and I remember one time,…
